{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ExternalMetadataMessagePackObject_GeneratedFormatterHasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        string externalSource = \"using MessagePack;\\n\\nnamespace ExternalLib\\n{\\n    [MessagePackObject]\\n    public class ExternalMessagePackObject\\n    {\\n        [Key(0)]\\n        public int Value { get; set; }\\n    }\\n}\\n\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation externalCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ExternalLib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(externalSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using MemoryStream externalAssemblyStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = externalCompilation.Emit(externalAssemblyStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(\"\\n\", emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        MetadataReference externalReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(externalAssemblyStream.ToArray());\n\n        string consumerSource = \"using MessagePack;\\nusing ExternalLib;\\n\\nnamespace ConsumerApp\\n{\\n    [MessagePackObject]\\n    public class LocalConsumerObject\\n    {\\n        [Key(0)]\\n        public ExternalMessagePackObject External { get; set; }\\n    }\\n}\\n\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation consumerCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ConsumerApp\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(consumerSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references.Add(externalReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePack.SourceGenerator.MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(\n            consumerCompilation,\n            out Compilation outputCompilation,\n            out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        var formatterSources = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Where(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"IMessagePackFormatter<\"))\n            .ToArray();\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(formatterSources);\n        Assert.All(\n            formatterSources,\n            source => Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", source.SourceText.ToString()));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n\n        var generatedFormatterTypes = GetAllTypes(outputCompilation.Assembly.GlobalNamespace)\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface)))\n            .ToArray();\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedFormatterTypes);\n        Assert.All(\n            generatedFormatterTypes,\n            formatterType => Assert.Contains(\n                formatterType.GetAttributes(),\n                attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr)));\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceSymbol ns)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return nested;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol deeper in GetNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return deeper;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}
